title: Needle Hunt
blurb: Find the lines that state a deadline in a long document.
lesson: Jev scores every line in one call, so it ranks many candidates at once, fast and cheaply.
why: Jev gets every line as its own Noul in a single request, so all 30 lines are scored together. The LLM reads the whole document and writes back the line numbers it picked.
Credit is shared by how many of the right lines each racer found without picking wrong ones.
